# fly.ai core

MIT-licensed core files from
[alextitonis/fly.ai](https://github.com/alextitonis/fly.ai/tree/d6d8e689e31f71df4fab0a711889a93d9983ccb6),
commit `d6d8e689e31f71df4fab0a711889a93d9983ccb6`, inspected September 12, 2026.
The original license is retained. No application, token, game or deployment code
is included. Data is downloaded separately from MaleCNS under CC BY 4.0.

Our preparation wrapper checks downloads against provider checksums where available
and records SHA-256 for every input; the original builder then processes those
already downloaded files. Model signs, normalization, gains and LIF dynamics remain
explicit modeling assumptions. This is not a recovered biological animal.
